label: Order
caption: MERRICK B. GARLAND, ATTORNEY GENERAL, ET AL. V. JENNIFER VANDERSTOK, ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the June 30, 2023 order and July 5, 2023 final judgment of the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas, case No. 4:22-cv-691, are hereby administratively stayed until 5 p.m. (EDT) on Friday, August 4, 2023. It is further ordered that any response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, August 2, 2023, by 5 p.m. (EDT).
